In case of no occurrence of complained communications under sub-regulation (5)(a), OAP shall communicate to the TAP to inform the complainant about the closure of complaint in a manner prescribed in the Code(s) of Practice; In case of occurrence of complained communications under sub-regulation (5)(a), OAP shall further examine, within two business days from the date of complaint, whether there are similar complaints or reports against the same sender; and in case, it is found that number of complaints against the sender are from ten or more than ten recipients over a period of last seven days, the OAP shall put sender under Usage Cap and at the same time shall initiate
